promise: The `hangar` command never resolves a credential or makes a network call. `hangar refresh` asks the running app to fetch, and the command itself only reads the cache.
why: The command line is fast enough to put behind a keystroke and costs no credential because it reads ~/.hangar/cache and nothing else. Adding `hangar refresh` made fetching from the shell tempting, and the easy version would have called EC2 straight from the command line. Checks for exit status 1 from grep, not `! grep`, so a broken pattern or a missing file fails the case rather than passing it (mistake 16).
